considerations: Review the service principal, credential changes and resource access.
Compare the source IP with known egress and require independent evidence before escalation.
Check Azure activity and resource audit logs for follow-on actions.
description: Review successful Entra service-principal sign-ins from a campaign-associated IP Microsoft reported.

evidence.claim: Microsoft reported successful service-principal sign-ins from a campaign-associated address across multiple application IDs. The date below is the earliest activity Microsoft describes.
evidence.location: Credential abuse via Entra ID and indicators sections

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: A successful sign-in from the published address warrants correlation with app ownership and expected egress.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Service Principal Sign-ins From a Reported IP

1.json:
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == "0" and IPAddress in ("199.19.77.84")
| project TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalName, ServicePrincipalId, IPAddress, ResourceDisplayName, ResultType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
